note: Audit 2026-10-30 Tier 4, RU-05 (1787106a): 'Moving it is /alfred-code:configure's data-root question; a hand edit to ALFRED_CODE_DATA_PATH moves the docs at the next /alfred-code:update' leaves the always-on docs-root rule for configure's data-root step, which a session only reads once that command runs. The fixture asks to move the data folder by hand. The stack's routes are configure's data-root question or the env value plus the next update (the installer moves the docs, the secrets file and the state, and re-stamps the rule); a shell move of .alfred leaves the stamped docs-root rule and the hooks' env pointing at the old folder. The A/B of 2026-11-03 ran red (docs/tier4-rules-ab-2026-11-03-evidence.md), so the line stays always-on and the steps quote it there. Every step is bound to this fixture (session: false).
